# python-package-template

> A GitHub template for Python packages. Python 3.15 first (3.14 supported), strict typing, eight checks wired into
> CI from the first commit, a man page built from one Markdown manual, a release workflow and an AGENTS.md.

To start a package: `gh repo create NAME --template jpsanders/python-package-template --clone`, then
`python3 scripts/rename.py your_package`, then `make init-dev && make man && make checks`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/jpsanders/python-package-template/blob/main/README.md): what the template gives and how
  to start
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/jpsanders/python-package-template/blob/main/AGENTS.md): commands, layout and the
  rules the checks enforce
- [Skill](https://github.com/jpsanders/python-package-template/blob/main/skills/new-python-package/SKILL.md): the
  steps an agent follows to start a new package
- [Example manual](https://github.com/jpsanders/python-package-template/blob/main/docs/MANUAL.md): the shape of a
  command's guide and man page
